quote_state.bid: latest BID tick at or before snapshot second
quote_state.ask: latest ASK tick at or before snapshot second
quote_state.freshness: both sides age <=2000 ms and ask >= bid > 0

causal_feature_law.median_spread_baseline: median valid spread_bps over integer-second snapshots t-60 through t-1; require >0
causal_feature_law.consistency: among nonzero one-second mid changes ending at t over the prior 5 seconds, fraction matching impulse sign
causal_feature_law.quote_intensity_ratio: raw BID+ASK tick count over (t-5s,t] divided by one-twelfth of raw BID+ASK tick count over (t-60s,t]; require denominator >0
causal_feature_law.signal: all causal filters pass and abs(impulse_spread_units) >= frozen threshold

execution_and_response.signal_time: integer second t after all ticks timestamped <=t have been processed
execution_and_response.entry: integer-second quote state at t+1s; require fresh state
execution_and_response.direction_continuation: long if impulse>0, short if impulse<0
execution_and_response.direction_reversion: short if impulse>0, long if impulse<0
execution_and_response.exit: integer-second fresh quote state exactly holding_seconds after entry snapshot
execution_and_response.commission: not subtracted in primary pilot; any spread-net survivor must pass current commission truth plus EUR200 sizing/margin before expansion/promotion
execution_and_response.overlap: within each symbol x frozen cell, ignore new signals until scheduled exit
execution_and_response.missing: entry or exit snapshot not fresh => right-censor; no delay search, interpolation, synthetic quotes or stale-side repair

multiplicity.family: all 60 frozen symbol x threshold x direction-law x horizon cells
multiplicity.support_rule_predeclared: All 60 remain family members. Only cells meeting non-return support prerequisites (>=100 completed events, >=18 dates, >=10 ISO weeks, retention>=0.80) generate finite max-T statistics; others receive p=1.

robust_region_gate.within: same symbol and same direction_law only
robust_region_gate.adjacency: one step in impulse threshold or holding horizon

pilot_semantics.robust_survivor_next_step: freeze disjoint remaining-DEVELOPMENT-date expansion under same feature/response law, then current commission + volume lattice + margin/EUR200 gate
